reviews.review:
Absolutely amazing game.


This is an incredibly addicting experience, and while it may be hard for the first few hours, it's 101% worth getting into.
Grab a copy for yourself and a few good friends, or find an experienced squad to teach you (like I did) and fire away.

With mods, this game is all I want to play. I dream about it, I can't wait for the next mission, it's like ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ heroin but oh so perfect.

Currently I have <50 hours, so I'll probably update this as I gain more experience, but it's an incredibly immersive game that most definitely deserves your attention.

Amazing game with endless possibilities. It has definitely been around for a hot minute now, but this game continues to please. Greatly attributed to the developer/creative community. Tons of updates, skins, play styles...a good time

If I could, I would get my money back, but I gave the game too many shots to be able to do so.
So whats the problem? You may ask...

Well, lets start off with the bugs - and there are MANY
The game contains a lot of game or experience breaking bugs that are ancient old 
and absolutely suck all the fun out of the gameplay, but the devs dont seem to care anymore.

The Physics engine is outdated and completely broken when going on foot, in a vehicle, or in the air.
For example hitting a rock with a car causes it to explode like a bomb, and the same goes for landing just a little too hard.
And on foot its not any better for example you can clip through walls just by spamming the "climb over" key.
And the driving, oh boy the driving is hell, all the cars are pinned down like F1 racecars so you can take corners with a van at about 200 km/h without a problem, and when you hit a rock the size of a fist your vehicle explodes into a fireball.
The sounds of the vehicles sound like 2000's 8bit trash, planes and boats included.

Oof the optimalisation, the game doesnt run on solid 60 FPS with stuff spawned in even on pretty good PC's which is, considering the outdated looks, a complete failiure.

And there is sooo much else thats just wrong or broken about this game, 
but Iam not willing to spend any more time on this...

On the good side tho,

The gun play and balistics are pretty good, also the graphics are decent on higher settings.
Also the modding community is a blessing, without them the game would be dead a long time ago.

The sad thing is that there is no other decent military sim with such a huge backing behind it,
so if you are looking for a millitary sim - this is still probably your best choice.

But the worst thing is, that the stuff above wont ever get fixed because the devs are gonna leave the game
after the upcoming Tanks DLC update as they officially announced - so goodbye Arma III

Thank you for spending your time reading this review, and I hope you have a nice day!
Played it once or twice, a brilliant immersive game.
